executiveSummary.headline: Turn Recognized Luxury Assets Into Clearer Business and Meetings Signals
executiveSummary.lead: Grand Fiesta Americana Chapultepec has credible assets—Spa 19th, Azur, Chapultepec Castle views, Grand Club, dog-friendly positioning, and a Forbes Travel Guide listing—but appeared in only 4.7% of comparable consideration answers and 16.7% of eligible scenarios. Those results do not diagnose a website defect. They support a focused review of whether business, meetings, club-floor, and verified luxury signals are presented with enough precision and consistency.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is based on 9 of 192 comparable monitored answers; Scenario Presence is based on 8 of 48 eligible scenarios. The #4 of 5 peer value is retained from the certified lean Fiesta Rewards baseline, whose peer section was not visible. None of these measures represents bookings, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Low Consideration Despite Recognized Core Amenities
themes.what: ADP recognized spa and restaurant attributes, but meeting-space recognition was only 24.6% despite seven halls and published capacity up to 220.
themes.whyItMatters: The gap is a reason to investigate business-content emphasis, not evidence that leisure copy or the website caused the measured result.

themes.title: Capacity Language Needs Qualification
themes.what: The official site and Cvent support 220 seated, while Forbes inspector copy says El Castillo allows all 300 guests to admire the views.
themes.whyItMatters: The 300 reference may describe a different use or editorial wording. Sales should establish one setup-qualified source of truth before requesting changes.

themes.title: Awards and Contact Details Need Precision
themes.what: The official Forbes section uses vague ratings-and-stars language without naming the current rating, and the page displays +52 443 numbers that should be verified for a Mexico City property.
themes.whyItMatters: Specific, approved award and contact facts reduce uncertainty for guests, planners, and automated systems.

priorities.action: Commercial team: sharpen meetings, Grand Club, and business signals
Leadership: confirm and state the current Forbes recognition
Operations: verify all public phone numbers

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: Official pages clearly present approved meetings, Grand Club, Spa 19th, Azur, and business-location strengths; public capacity wording is setup-qualified; Forbes language states only the confirmed current recognition; and every displayed phone number has a documented routing purpose.
executiveSummary.closing: The hotel does not need speculative claims. It needs clearer organization of verified strengths and disciplined correction of facts that buyers may compare. That work can improve information quality and sales readiness, while any later change in AI consideration must be measured rather than promised.
